headline.purpose: Current map scope; reduces to 20px below 900px.

body.purpose: IBM Plex Sans body with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: more-menu
shadows.purpose: Lift the More menu above the viewer.

motion.name: control-fast
motion.purpose: Outlined button and row background transitions.

motion.name: control-standard
motion.purpose: Field, chip, breadcrumb and disclosure transitions.

motion.name: route-card
motion.purpose: Prepared route hover and focus transitions.

motion.name: eye-navigation
motion.purpose: Eye control background and border transitions.

motion.name: scope-flight
motion.purpose: Continuous camera flight; cubic ease-in-out; immediate under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-css
motion.purpose: User motion preference overrides CSS transitions and animations.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Open a part or play a prepared flow using the current eye accent.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 600 var(--text-md) / 1.45 var(--font-label); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A compact outlined action; Back and Overview use a 34px minimum height variant.
components.css: .ds-secondary { padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-main); border-radius: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); font: 400 var(--text-sm) / 1.45 var(--font-label); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms var(--ease-out), border-color 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--text-dim); background: var(--raised); } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text button
components.description: A secondary inline action, kept recognisable with an underline.
components.css: .ds-text { padding: 2px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--accent); font: 400 var(--text-sm) / 1.45 var(--font-label); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Optional local keyword matching supports browse-first capability discovery.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-keyword">Keyword (optional)</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-keyword" type="search" placeholder="Filter capabilities">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin: var(--space-2) 0 var(--space-1); color: var(--text-dim); font: 400 var(--text-sm) / 1.45 var(--font-label); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ground); color: var(--text); caret-color: var(--accent); font: 400 var(--text-md) / 1.45 var(--font-label); transition: border-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-main); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Eye navigation
components.description: Each eye has its own icon, name, purpose and selected outline; geometry remains stable.
components.css: .ds-eyes { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 0 0 10px; } .ds-eye { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 160px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: none; color: var(--text-dim); font: 500 var(--text-md) / 1 var(--font-head); letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-eye svg { flex: none; color: var(--eye-atlas); } .ds-eye-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; text-align: left; } .ds-eye strong { color: var(--text); font-size: var(--text-lg); font-weight: 600; } .ds-eye-purpose { font: 400 var(--text-sm) / 1 var(--font-label); } .ds-eye:hover { background: var(--raised); } .ds-eye[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--eye-atlas); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--eye-atlas) 8%, var(--panel)); color: var(--eye-atlas); } .ds-eye:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Filter chip
components.description: A factual capability filter with a visible pressed state.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: none; color: var(--text-dim); font: 400 var(--text-sm) / 1.45 var(--font-label); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms var(--ease-out), border-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 13%, var(--panel)); color: var(--accent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Panel frame
components.description: A compact bordered control surface with separated title and scrollable body.
components.html:
Capabilities

Browse what the system already does.
components.css: .ds-frame { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); } .ds-frame-title { margin: 0; padding: 13px 14px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font: 600 var(--text-lg) / 1.4 var(--font-head); letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-frame-body { padding: 14px; color: var(--text-dim); font: 400 var(--text-md) / 1.45 var(--font-label); }

components.name: Prepared route card
components.description: A browsable prepared explanation, distinct from live telemetry.
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 15px 13px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, var(--panel)); color: var(--text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms var(--ease-out), background 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-route strong { font: 600 1rem / 1.3 var(--font-head); } .ds-route-meta { color: var(--text-dim); font: 400 var(--text-xs) / 1.45 var(--font-label); } .ds-route:hover, .ds-route:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 9%, var(--panel)); } .ds-route:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
The owner supplied cyan/amber science fiction HUD references to replace the quiet neutral viewer. Ink-blue surfaces, structural brackets, luminous routes, and distinct instrument palettes make architecture exploration expressive while familiar controls keep the map usable.

The architecture stays spatially stable as Atlas, Tracer, Radar, and Sonar change its reading. Motion explains entry into a scope and progress through a prepared flow. Resource outlines and repository identity carry real distinctions; decoration never claims traffic was observed.
keyCharacteristics: A dominant architecture map with compact supporting rails.
Four recognisable eye palettes over stable geometry.
Crisp structural lines, restrained corners, and readable unglowing text.
Continuous cutaway navigation and a visible prepared-flow token.

rules.name: The Meaningful Colour Rule
rules.body: Couple every colour meaning with a name, icon, shape, or explicit state. Keep diagnostic roles distinct from eye palettes.

rules.name: The Signal Glow Rule
rules.body: Use light to reveal a route, selection, or capability; keep reading surfaces and text unglowing.

dos: **Do** preserve the learned map when switching eyes.
**Do** distinguish repository identity from logical system and external-resource identity.
**Do** keep Back, Overview, pause, and step actions reachable alongside the map.
**Do** show purpose and reuse information before technical evidence expansions.
**Do** respect reduced motion and pair colour with text, icon, or shape.
donts: **Don't** invent telemetry, decorative metrics, ranking scores, or research claims.
**Don't** present prepared flows as observed traffic or connected neighbours as proven impact.
**Don't** glow text, flash signals, or run decorative motion at rest.
**Don't** copy franchise artwork or replace familiar controls with unexplained HUD glyphs.
